title: Session & Security
subtitle: Configure per-role session TTL and concurrent session limits.
roleNameHelp: Permission group slug or role identifier (e.g. teacher_default).
maxConcurrentSessionsHelp: Between 1 and 50 active sessions per user.
ttlOutOfRange: TTL must be between 60 and 2,419,200 seconds.
